author: MetaBallStudios
description:
This video shows the depths to which some fictional underground facilities, caves, and other complexes extend. Do you know how deep Black Mesa or the city of Zion from The Matrix is? Check out this video and be amazed!

Note: This includes not only underground facilities, but also cities, caves, and other complexes located underground.

~ - Approximate
± - Error range
*UM - Unreliable Measure
White texts have sources
Yellow texts are MBS estimates 
Red texts are extremely imprecise MBS estimates
